svg.title: Short Squeeze Screener — conceptual diagram
svg.desc: read-only market screener. Conceptual technical diagram, not a screenshot. A research screener that ranks short-squeeze candidates from structured market data, with data-quality checks at every step and a frozen demo mode for reproducible runs.
